Name: Chushan-rishathaim
Summary: Chushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia, was the first oppressor of Israel in Judges; Israel served him eight years until Othniel delivered them.
KeyStory: After Israel did evil, God sold them into the hand of Chushan-rishathaim, whom they served eight years before Othniel's deliverance.
LifeLesson: Oppression in Judges always follows the same pattern: evil, bondage, crying out, and a deliverer.
